facts.claim: 'Perfect' is performed by Ed Sheeran and is taken from his third studio album, ÷.
'Perfect' by Ed Sheeran first entered the UK Official Singles Chart on 16/03/2017 (2017 release year), on the Asylum label.
'Perfect' entered the UK Official Singles Chart at Number 4 and climbed to Number 1, where it stayed for six weeks; it was Ed Sheeran's fourth UK Number 1 single.
The Official Charts Company notes versions of 'Perfect' released as a duet with Beyoncé and with Andrea Bocelli.
'At Last' is a song by Etta James, one of the songs that made her Chess Records' first major female star after she signed with Chess in 1960.
Etta James received four Grammy Awards, including a 2003 lifetime achievement award, and was inducted into the Grammy Hall of Fame (1999 and 2008) and the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame (1993).

insider_details.detail: If a couple loves 'Perfect' but wants a gentler walk, the Official Charts Company lists duet versions with Beyoncé and with Andrea Bocelli, so check which recording the musicians or DJ will play before the day.
